name: Is AEO more important than traditional SEO for a dental practice?

mainEntity.name: Is AEO more important than traditional SEO for a dental practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO and traditional SEO are complementary rather than mutually exclusive for dental practices. Traditional SEO focuses on broader keyword rankings and website traffic, while AEO targets direct answers in AI-powered search and voice assistants. While AEO is increasingly critical due to the rise of voice search and AI integration, a strong foundation in traditional SEO is still necessary for overall online visibility. Combining both strategies provides a comprehensive approach to capture various types of patient searches and maximize online presence.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO and traditional SEO are complementary; AEO targets direct answers in AI search, while traditional SEO focuses on broader rankings. Both are important for dental practice visibility.
